youtube_description:
So many new advances in conversational AI models like Google AI LaMDA and GPT-3, and more (used for chatbots and voice assistants like Siri and Alexa) but for those new to conversational AI, understanding the difference between models can be tricky. Join me in walking through high-level overview of the Google AI LAMDA model and why it claims to do conversation so well.

Note: all opinions are my own as a data scientist and researcher in the field and are not representative of the tool/company being reviewed, nor of any other company.
